name: MDF: Magical Defense Force
source:
A Magical Girl blew into town one day, rescuing local cynical loner Frank Krieg. Due to circumstances beyong their control, they now have to live together.
Frank and Michiki will attempt to survive evil monsters, secret organizations, school, and each other as they seek out other Magical Girls like her.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2292960/]Steam[/url]]
